l Crystal Approximation); pass --split-
                        site-mixture to instead keep them as separate species-
                        resolved atoms. Note that this is per-atom and
                        distinct from the VASP INCAR VCA tag, which lists one
                        weight per element row in POSCAR.
  --sp, --save-params   Save parameters that can run phonopy in
                        phonopy_params.yaml.
  --split-site-mixture  [Experimental] With --site-mixture, keep overlapping
                        atoms as separate species-resolved atoms instead of
                        merging them into mixed-species sites.
  --sscha SSCHA_ITERATIONS
                        Number of iterations in SSCHA calculation
  -t, --thermal-property
                        Output thermal properties
  --td, --thermal-displacements
                        Output thermal displacements
  --tdm, --thermal-displacement-matrix
                        Output thermal displacement matrices
  --tdm-cif TEMPERATURE, --thermal-displacement-matrix-cif TEMPERATURE
                        Write cif with aniso_U for which temperature is
                        specified
  --temperature TEMPERATURE
                        (Deprecated) A temperature used to generate random
                        displacements.
  --tmax TMAX           Maximum calculated temperature
  --tmin TMIN           Minimum calculated temperature
  --tolerance SYMMETRY_TOLERANCE
                        Symmetry tolerance to search
  --tstep TSTEP         Calculated temperature step
  -v, --verbose         Detailed information is shown.
  --writedm             Write dynamical matrices. This has to be used with
                        QPOINTS setting (or --qpoints)
  --writefc             Write FORCE_CONSTANTS
  --writefc-format WRITEFC_FORMAT
                        Force constants output file-format
  --xyz-projection      Project PDOS x, y, z directions in Cartesian
                        coordinates
